# Malaysia

> [!summary] Data available
> Malaysia has 78 WorldCuisines dishes (only 11 Malaysia-only) and a few hundred recipes, plus strong ethnobotany (Burkill). Start with [[WorldCuisines]] and [[RecipeDB2]] for food and Duke's ETHNOBOT and [[KNApSAcK Family]] for plants; MyFCD is only in the Backlog.

## Foods & dishes
- [[WorldCuisines]] 78 dishes (11 Malaysia-only; most shared with Singapore/Indonesia); [[FmLAMA]] 17; [[World Wide Dishes]] 5.
- [[RecipeDB2]] ≈220 (v1); [[Food.com Recipes and Interactions]] 119; [[IndicRecipeNutri]] 65 (Indian sites).
- Not in [[BLEnD]] (Malay is covered for Singapore).

## Ingredients & food composition
No FCT processed. [[Malaysian Food Composition Database]] (668 prepared foods; candidate, priority 2); [[ASEAN Food Composition Database]] (priority 2).

## Compounds & traditional medicine
[[Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases|Duke]] 3,220 records, 1,288 taxa (Burkill 1966; Malay traditional uses); [[KNApSAcK Family]] 865 records (376 edible / 489 medicinal); [[CMAUP]] 94 plants; [[NPASS]] 193 pairs; [[Exposome-Explorer]] 22 rows; [[HERB]] 65 meta-analyses. Global resources without country labels (FooDB, SpiceRx, FlavorDB2, Phenol-Explorer, CTD, HMDB, FoodAtlas, FooDrugs) apply via [[Global]].

## Gaps
No FCT, no Malay-language recipes, no BLEnD culture; Malay, Chinese and Indian Malaysian cuisines are not separated.
